description: Ministry of  Labour, Tarade Union Relations and Sabaragamuwa Development - Notify that appointed G.A. Yasanayake as employee's Representatives of the Wages Board for the Retail & Wholesale Trade in place of Mrs. P. M. Anandasiri . This Appointment is valid since 01.07.2018 to 30.11.2020
categorisation: This gazette announces the appointment of a specific individual (Ms. Geetha Anoma Yasanayake) to a government board (Wages Board for the Retail & Wholesale Trade). It names the person and provides her basic title ("Employee's Representatives") but does not include any detailed description of her portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio information.
